about: Answers in the AI test JSON (OpenRobertaServer/src/main/resources/ai/tests.md), the worlds nepoTest.aiFormat.checkAnswer made of them and the Tests-tab blocks nepoTest.aiFormat.suiteXml made of them, in the browser. Regenerate when aiFormat changes (docs/ai/nepo-ai-tests.md).

cases.name: 1-follow-the-line

tests.name: On the line, it follows it to the goal
tests.scenario: Given the robot starts on the line at A, when the program runs, then it follows the line and reaches Goal 1 at its end without bumping into anything.

equivalence_partitions.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line
equivalence_partitions.selected_realization: A, on the line's first point, facing along it

equivalence_partitions.dimension: what is ahead on the line
equivalence_partitions.selected_realization: nothing is on the line in this world

expected_results: It follows the line and reaches Goal 1 at the line's end.

postconditions.description: By the end of the run, the robot has touched Goal 1.
During the whole run, it never bumps into anything.

assumptions: The end of the line is where it should get to.

tests.reason: Following the line from a start on it is what the learner said.

tests.name: Started beside the line, it finds it
tests.scenario: Given the robot starts at B, 8 cm beside the line, when the program runs, then it finds the line and still reaches Goal 1.

equivalence_partitions.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line
equivalence_partitions.selected_realization: B, 8 cm beside the line, facing along it

expected_results: It turns towards the line, finds it and follows it to Goal 1.

postconditions.description: By the end of the run, the robot has touched Goal 1.

assumptions: The curve to the right on the floor is meant to find the line again.

tests.reason: Another class of start: off the line, so the program must find it first.

tests.name: Just off the line's edge, it finds it
tests.scenario: Given the robot starts at C, its line tracker just off the black line, when the program runs, then it finds the line and reaches Goal 1.

boundary_values.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line
boundary_values.boundary: the line's edge under the line tracker
boundary_values.selected_realization: C, 1.5 cm beside the line's middle: the line tracker is just off the black core
boundary_values.rationale: Just outside the edge the program takes the else part first and must still find the line.

expected_results: It finds the line from just beside it and follows it to Goal 1.

postconditions.description: By the end of the run, the robot has touched Goal 1.

assumptions: The curve to the right on the floor is meant to find the line again.

tests.reason: The outside side of the line's edge.

tests.name: Just on the line's edge, it follows it
tests.scenario: Given the robot starts at D, its line tracker just on the edge of the black line, when the program runs, then it follows the line and reaches Goal 1.

boundary_values.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line
boundary_values.boundary: the line's edge under the line tracker
boundary_values.selected_realization: D, 0.3 cm beside the line's middle: the line tracker is just on the black core
boundary_values.rationale: Just inside the edge the line tracker sees black: the program follows the line from there.

expected_results: It follows the line from its edge to Goal 1.

postconditions.description: By the end of the run, the robot has touched Goal 1.
During the whole run, it never bumps into anything.

assumptions: The end of the line is where it should get to.

tests.reason: The inside side of the line's edge.

tests.name: Stops before the box on the line
tests.scenario: Given a box on the line, when the program runs for 40 s, then the robot stops in front of the box without bumping into it, and stays there.

equivalence_partitions.dimension: what is ahead on the line
equivalence_partitions.selected_realization: the Box t2 on the line, 120 cm ahead of A

expected_results: It follows the line, stops when the box is ahead, and stays there.

postconditions.description: During the whole run, it never bumps into the box.
Whenever the box is ahead, it stands still.

tests.reason: Stopping at an obstacle is what the learner said.

tests.name: Right in front of the box, it stays
tests.scenario: Given the robot starts at E with the box 2 cm ahead of its sensors, when the program runs, then it doesn't move and doesn't bump into the box.

boundary_values.dimension: what is ahead on the line
boundary_values.selected_realization: E: the box is 8 cm ahead of the axle, 2 cm ahead of the sensors
boundary_values.rationale: Inside the sensors' range the program must stop at once.

expected_results: It stands still from the start, in front of the box.

postconditions.description: During the whole run, it never bumps into the box.
From 0.5 s on to the end, it stands still.

tests.reason: The inside side of the obstacle sensors' range.

tests.name: The box just out of sight, it still stops
tests.scenario: Given the robot starts at F with the box 4 cm ahead of its sensors, when the program runs, then it drives on, stops when it sees the box, and doesn't bump into it.

boundary_values.dimension: what is ahead on the line
boundary_values.selected_realization: F: the box is 10 cm ahead of the axle, 4 cm ahead of the sensors
boundary_values.rationale: Just outside the range the program drives on first, and must stop as soon as it sees the box.

expected_results: It drives on a little, then stops in front of the box and stays there.

postconditions.description: During the whole run, it never bumps into the box.
Whenever the box is ahead, it stands still.

tests.reason: The outside side of the obstacle sensors' range.

consolidation_notes: The start on the line also stands for nothing ahead on the line, so there is no second test without a box.
warnings: The learner didn't say where the line should end: the tests take its end as the goal.

cases.name: 3-park-in-the-box

tests.name: After PLAY, it parks in the box
tests.scenario: Given PLAY is pressed after 0.5 s, when the program runs, then the robot drives into the box and stops completely inside it.
expected_results: After PLAY it drives into the box and stops there.

postconditions.description: When the run ends, the robot is completely inside the box.
During the whole run, it never bumps into anything.

assumptions: The box is where the program stops: the learner gave no distance.

tests.reason: Parking after PLAY is what the learner said.

tests.name: Without PLAY, it waits
tests.scenario: Given nobody presses PLAY, when the program runs for 5 s, then the robot stays where it is.

equivalence_partitions.selected_realization: no key press in the set-up

assumptions: Without PLAY the robot shouldn't move.

tests.reason: The other class of the key: never pressed.

consolidation_notes: PLAY pressed after 3 s is the same class as after 0.5 s (pressed while it waits): left out.
